tests: Jobs API GET /api/v1/jobs returns every persisted active job for an administrator
scenarios: Administrator job listing returns jobs across persisted teams

tests: Jobs API GET /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name when authorized when the job is absent returns 404
scenarios: Missing production job lookup returns HTTP 404

tests: Jobs API GET /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/builds when authorized when the job is naturally absent returns 404
scenarios: Missing production job build listing returns HTTP 404

tests: Jobs API PUT /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/pause persists the authenticated user's pause state
scenarios: Production pause endpoint persists authenticated pause state

tests: Jobs API PUT /api/v1/teams/:team_name/pipelines/:pipeline_name/jobs/:job_name/pause returns 404 for a missing configured job
scenarios: Production pause endpoint returns HTTP 404 for a missing job

scenarios: Production unpause endpoint returns HTTP 404 for a missing job
